responsibility: Portable environment-variable support for GNAT runtime and tools. It implements imported services to read, set, enumerate, unset, and clear environment variables across Unix, Windows, Darwin, VxWorks, and other hosts, including platform-specific fallbacks where unsetenv/clearenv are missing and target-specific access to the real environ vector. This file owns environment mutation semantics, while env.h only publishes the API.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the env pair: it contains the host-specific code for getenv/setenv/environ/unsetenv/clearenv, including Darwin _NSGetEnviron handling, VxWorks environment access, and fallback mutation logic where unsetenv or clearenv are unavailable. Unlike gcc/ada/env.h, it defines the platform-dependent behavior of environment management rather than just exposing function declarations.
